title: Cobweb Torcher
description: Use a torch on a cobweb to burn it away!
body:
Cobweb Torcher adds a simple but satisfying mechanic to Minecraft — use a torch to burn away cobwebs. Perfect for clearing out abandoned mineshafts, dungeons, and spider caves without wearing out your shears or a sword.

**Features:**
- Burn cobwebs instantly with a torch
- Fire and smoke particles on destruction
- Burns may spread to adjacent cobwebs
- Configurable chance to consume the torch on use
- Toggle each torch type individually (torch, soul torch, redstone torch, copper torch)
- Full in-game config screen via ModMenu + YACL (both optional)
- Lightweight

-----
